source.title: PEC modernisation — global UI/UX parity, server-client reconciliation and hybrid PR replenishment (planning gate)
source.body:
## Purpose
Govern a comprehensive Procurement Execution Console (PEC) modernisation while retaining existing production approvals, contracts, security, and shared Electron/PWA implementation.

## Owner requirements (2026-11-11)
1. All applicable tables: bounded infinite scroll with deterministic ordering, latest-wins and filter reset.
2. Wide screens: descriptive icon + text buttons; narrow screens: accessible icon-only controls.
3. Draft manual/non-PR indents: editable quantities with server enforcement.
4. Draft manual/non-PR indents: editable indent dates with server enforcement.
5. Display indent date separately from approval date in indent lens.
6. Inventory server controls versus client surfaces, classify expose/retain backend-only/park.
7. Hybrid PR demand: production-plan requirement plus stock-replenishment need, without double counting; governed policy requiring owner review.
8. Make newly created indent immediately available for vendor mapping; investigate snapshot refresh and client cache dependencies.
9. Review 'Excess & Overshoot' terminology; distinguish its actual workflows.
10. End-to-end server/client review and responsive visual audit.

## Existing repository governance
Read docs/procurement-execution/{README,MASTER_PROGRAMME,IMPLEMENTATION_RULES,CHANGELOG_DECISIONS}.md. Existing programme covers prior WP01 and is not blanket authorisation for new changes. Extend rather than duplicate documentation. Prior PR #238 vendor-wise latest-wins fix is baseline; protect it. Work on isolated PEC branch; do not touch costing/e-Aushadhi or local protected WIP.

## Preliminary read-only server evidence
public.proc_indent_header has indent_date, approved_date, status, source_pr_id; public.proc_indent_line has requested_qty. Existing server operations include proc_indent_add_line, proc_indent_create, proc_indent_create_from_pr, proc_indent_set_status, proc_indent_recommend_vendor, proc_indent_recommend_vendors_bulk, proc_indent_resync_from_pr and snapshot generation functions. Presence of functions does not establish client exposure or safe draft-edit semantics.

## Staged gate
G0 full repo and server baseline: lens-by-lens screenshot/DOM inventory, action inventory, RPC/function privileges and schema, shared design components, shared source-of-truth Electron/PWA, baseline tests.
G1 contract proposal: exact draft-only predicates, date semantics, quote/replenishment formula alternatives, snapshot freshness and role controls. Independent ChatGPT audit and owner approval of materially new policies.
G2 server changes: migrations/RPC wrappers/permissions and regression proof (ChatGPT-owned, only after approval).
G3 Claude bulk client branch: autonomous analysis, changes, tests, self-review, correction and PR within locked scope; no merge/deploy/version bump.
G4 independent review: security, functional correctness, responsive visuals and parity, all tables, cross-module regression; report evidence.
G5 owner acceptance, explicit merge approval, PWA verification, Electron release deferred to subsequent release.

## Design acceptance
Professional consistent titles, home/back, spacing, colour tokens, font families/sizes/weights, headings, button labels, accessible focus/title/tooltips, tables, error/empty/loading states, modals and narrow-screen behavior. Avoid introducing duplicated HTML/JS/CSS for Electron and PWA; inspect canonical shared paths. Verify refresh and permissions.

## Hybrid PR design considerations (decision pending)
Use demand forecast/production consumption + lead-time demand + safety stock minus available stock and confirmed inbound, with reserved stock/expiry/UOM adjustments where appropriate. Net additional PR qty must not double count plan requirements or existing open PRs/indents/POs. Show source breakdown, snapshot, assumptions and override audit. Evaluate item-level min/max/reorder-point, demand variability and supplier lead times; no invented parameters, no automatic purchases.

## Safety
No production data mutation or SQL deployment via this issue. Preserve manual indent entry order, canonical indent_line_sort_no, existing historical dates, quantity totals, vendor selection, and authorization. No silent changes to service-worker cache/version or PWA release behavior.

## Next
Deliver a concise evidence-based G0/G1 contract and Claude bulk execution brief for owner review before modifying sensitive server behaviour or merging client changes.

## 2026-11-11 — Scope refinement and historical programme reconciliation (read-only review)

**Owner directive:** PEC shall become professional, future-proof and ERP-style end to end, including server business rules, execution lifecycle and global SASV design language. Keep implementation economical: reuse canonical code, no gratuitous migrations, no documentation churn; finish unresolved earlier items. Maintain progress indicators in every PEC update.

**Verified by reading current repository documentation:**
- Existing docs/procurement-execution/MASTER_PROGRAMME.md covers a **bounded corrective programme**, not the new ERP modernisation. WP00/WP01 are stated CLOSED; their actual historical outcomes must be preserved.
- WP02 (operational stabilisation) remains NOT OPEN.
- WP02-A (PR PDF continuation header, DEC-016) remains IN REVIEW in master; PR #58 exists but its merge/release/operator acceptance state must be independently rechecked.
- Parked other indent-reference popups should be re-evaluated in the global UI parity audit.
- The November vendor-wise search fix has its own VWL_SEARCH_RELIABILITY_20261108.md; main master does not yet reflect newer reliability work.
- Master contains stale historical G0/G1 checkboxes alongside its WP01 closure. Reconcile as documentation discrepancy, not automatic functional regression.
- Previously noted global migration-history drift remains separate; no bulk repair under PEC.

**New phase:** PEC-ERP-MOD (within existing docs tree, preserving WP00/WP01 history). Six outcome gates:
1. G0 documented current-state baseline and unresolved legacy triage.
2. G1 approved function/policy contract: inventory, draft edits, immediate vendor mapping, hybrid replenishment.
3. G2 verified server contract implementation.
4. G3 autonomous Claude bulk client implementation tested on isolated shared-code branch.
5. G4 independent functional, security, responsive and integration acceptance.
6. G5 approved merge + live PWA verification; Electron rollout in later release.

**Progress protocol:** report `verified gates / 6`, not subjective percent. Distinguish evidence complete, in progress, pending and parked. Current: 0/6 verified; G0 ACTIVE. Historical WP00/WP01 remain closed and are not counted as newly completed gates.

**Documentation protocol:** existing README / MASTER_PROGRAMME / IMPLEMENTATION_RULES / CHANGELOG_DECISIONS remain canonical. Update them through a focused reviewed documentation PR as investigation and implementation advance; use this issue for immediate rolling evidence. No unreviewed direct-to-main edits, no premature 'completed' labels.

**Next gate:** reconcile PR #58 plus other existing PEC open items, current module client surfaces, and authoritative live RPC capabilities before defining G1. No production changes authorized by this comment.

## Lane A findings — 2026-11-11 (live read-only definition audit)
1. `create_pr_from_mrp_plan_pec_internal` sums `v_mrp_procurement_plan.procure_qty` over chosen months; MRP already handles opening stock, gross demand, MOQ, carry and closing. Additional replenishment must be netted against existing demand, not naively added.
2. `v_proc_indent_line_buylist_base` relies on `published_run_id` snapshot generation; `proc_indent_set_status_pec_internal` enqueues refresh on approval but does not synchronously publish. Vendor mapping step also uses published balances/candidates. This explains the temporary readiness delay, while exact latency/correct mitigation still needs proof. Snapshot was caught up at revision 110/110/110, published run 180 at 2026-11-11 12:13 UTC.
3. Existing `proc_indent_add_line_pec_internal` UPSERT replaces requested_qty for existing lines and allows edits outside draft (with reason for approved/issued). It does not enforce manual/no-PR draft eligibility. Do not expose it naively for the requested UI; propose narrow governed draft-edit RPCs without silently breaking legacy behavior.
4. `proc_indent_recommend_vendor_pec_internal` uses live ranking, but bulk recommendation uses published snapshot candidates/balance. Evaluate parity and freshness before any fix.
5. SQL evidence documented in draft PR #287's `ERP_MODERNISATION_G0_20261111.md` (updated commit `5d287cd`). No production changes. Progress remains G0 ACTIVE, 0/6 independently verified.

## Lane A S1/S2 contract precision update — 2026-11-11
- Live `proc_indent_header` and `proc_indent_line` already have AFTER INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE lifecycle-audit triggers, capturing before/after records; S1 can reuse these with mandatory edit reason and optimistic concurrency, no duplicate audit architecture.
- Current read-only data shape: **35 standalone approved indents** (12 with sourcing decisions), **6 PR-linked approved indents** (all 6 with sourcing decisions), **0 draft indents**. Cannot claim live draft mutation acceptance; test with isolated/nonproduction fixtures before any deployment.
- **Critical distinction:** `proc_indent_set_vendor_selection_pec_internal` permits manual vendor assignment on draft/approved/issued lines, requiring active vendor and a reason when no recommendation/rate or an override. `proc_indent_recommend_vendors_bulk` uses live ranked candidates but is approved/issued only; `proc_indent_recommend_and_accept_vendors_step_pec_internal` uses published generation and is approved/issued only. Vendor-wise Buying List is published only. Do not mistakenly block existing draft mapping, nor claim all vendor actions wait on a snapshot.
- Active cron **job 65** runs every minute and processes one of **four** snapshot stages per call; readiness after approval may take multiple ticks despite near-zero reported stage execution duration. Aim for immediate **manual draft vendor selection** from fresh current-state reads and explicit 'preparing vendor candidates' readiness for published bulk/buylist. Consider only separately validated improvements to publish latency, retaining atomic generation integrity.
- Updated G1 proposal in draft PR #287 commit `8f7ba533`. No production SQL, data, grants, refresh triggers or client merges.

## PEC G1 server pagination — legacy ordering parity corrections verified (12 Nov 2026)
Independent review found that new paged RPCs originally changed UI sorting: Vendor-wise should place UNASSIGNED last and sort by vendor/item names, PR/Indent tables should sort by descending ID, and Excess must prioritise `net_unallocated_qty DESC`, then voucher date DESC and purchase fact ID tie-break. **All four live RPCs corrected** and the single unmerged migration updated in draft PR #323 (commits `d051cd9`, `be12b7f`). Repeatable source/metadata regression (latest `scripts/pec-g1-paged-read-contract-verify.sql`, commit `f85a82d`) executed **PASS** (`PEC_G1_LEGACY_CLIENT_SORT_PARITY_PASS`). Vendor 834/834 order positions matched legacy exactly (0 mismatches, first UNASSIGNED at #636); Excess full 13,311/13,311 positions matched current stable client sort (0 mismatches). First two 200-row pages remain disjoint in both high-volume lists. PR/Indent live function sort clauses confirmed. No procurement data altered.

**Performance diagnostic:** single admin EXPLAIN ANALYZE runs: Excess `count(*) OVER()` page of 100 rows ~1116.9ms and 18,253 cache buffer hits; legacy unpaged view ~943.1ms and 18,285 hits. NOT controlled p95 or representative network timings; **do not claim server speedup**. Their new server paging functions lack equivalent server filter inputs; switching now would produce wrong matching-page/total results. Exact filter contract and sorting/benchmark caveat documented in PR #323 ledger commit `8003017`. Vendor-wise existing upstream filters exist but operational vendor filter requires further check. Do not switch any lens until pagination/filter/export and real-account tests pass.
